title: Recognize Your Weakness, Strengthen Your Faith
main_theme: God does not require us to pretend to be strong; surrender weakness to Him and grow in faith through His strength.
summary: The speaker says we hide our weakness, but Paul's thorn shows God's power is made perfect in weakness. Recognize it, surrender it, pray honestly, and be transformed. Your weakness is the doorway to His strength.
key_points: God's power is made perfect in weakness
When your strength ends, His begins
